mentions.name: sshfs
mentions.description: A kernel extension-free sshfs for macOS, implemented as a standalone command-line binary that proxies NFS to SFTP. It requires no special permissions, app sandboxing, or user approval in System Settings (unlike an earlier FSKit-based attempt), works out of the box, and delivers reasonable performance.
mentions.problem: Existing sshfs on macOS depends on kernel extensions, and the FSKit route is too constrained by the extension security model, which requires app sandboxing and user approval in System Settings.
mentions.source_excerpt: A kernel extension-less sshfs for macOS. I tried using FSKit and got halfway before I felt too constrained by the extension security model (must be app sandboxed, must be approved by the user in system settings). Now it’s just a standalone command line binary that doesn’t require any special permissions since it proxies NFS to SFTP.
